outing.hero_prompt_english: Mihong Park in Miyun town: the Bai River with a small traditional stone bridge and a distinct simple steel pedestrian bridge in the distance, public park path, willow and autumn tree canopies. Adults stroll on the bank with a warm drink, ordinary city buildings far behind. Riverbank mosaic scene, not a reservoir shoreline. Original peaceful full-bleed vertical artwork, layered filled background. No text, letters, logos, copied artwork, or invented maps. Adults in opaque everyday clothes only if people appear.
